name: Dream Detective
source:
Dream Detective is an investigative mini-game where you help three thoughts piece back together the half-forgotten dreams of their human to help him with his day.

Is it a visual novel? Is it a puzzle game? Try it out and decide for yourself!

[From [url=https://lauragames.itch.io/dream-detective]official site[/url]]
translation:
《Dream Detective》是一款调查小游戏。你将帮助三个思绪，拼凑出它们的主人已经忘却大半的梦境，助他度过这一天。

它究竟是视觉小说，还是解谜游戏？亲自玩一玩，再作出判断吧！

[摘自[url=https://lauragames.itch.io/dream-detective]官方网站[/url]]
